title: Fluency: nuance, choices & connectors
description: Hand-selected conversational vocabulary with contextual Mandarin examples.

cards.english: at last; in the end; finally
since; as; this being the case
As much as possible; try one's best
not to be concerned; regardless of; no matter
Know how to; will; be likely to
Again; then, for a future action
Only then; not until; only (context dependent)
Not have; there is no; have not

grammar.pinyin: Dì yī cì cháng shì nán miǎn huì jǐn zhāng.
grammar.english: It's natural to feel nervous on your first attempt.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān lín shí yǒu diǎn shì.
grammar.english: Something came up unexpectedly today.

grammar.pinyin: Qí shí wǒ yǐ qián méi yǒu qù guo nà li.
grammar.english: Actually, I've never been there before.

grammar.pinyin: Jīn tiān de jiāo tōng dǔ de bù dé liǎo.
grammar.english: Traffic is unbelievably congested today.

grammar.pinyin: Duō kuī nǐ bāng máng, wǒ men cái wán chéng le.
grammar.english: Thanks to your help, we managed to finish.

grammar.markup: {你}{去}{超市}{的}{时候}{顺便}{买}{点}{牛奶}{吧}。
grammar.pinyin: Nǐ qù chāo shì de shí hou shùn biàn mǎi diǎn niú nǎi ba.
grammar.english: While you're at the supermarket, pick up some milk.

grammar.markup: {总之}，{我们}{现在}{先}{解决}{最}{重要}{的}{问题}。
grammar.pinyin: Zǒng zhī, wǒ men xiàn zài xiān jiě jué zuì zhòng yào de wèn tí.
grammar.english: In short, let's solve the most important problem first.

grammar.pinyin: Tā bù jǐn huì zhōng wén, hái huì yīng yǔ.
grammar.english: He speaks not only Chinese but also English.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge bāo shāo wēi yǒu diǎn zhòng.
grammar.english: This bag is slightly heavy.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng diǎn yī fèn chǎo fàn, lìng wài zài yào yī bēi shuǐ.
grammar.english: I'd like fried rice, and another glass of water.

grammar.pinyin: Wàn yī chí dào le, jiù gěi wǒ fā xiāo xi.
grammar.english: If you happen to be late, send me a message.

grammar.markup: {反正}{今天}{下雨}，{我们}{在家}{休息}{吧}。
grammar.pinyin: Fǎn zheng jīn tiān xià yǔ, wǒ men zài jiā xiū xi ba.
grammar.english: Anyway, since it's raining, let's stay home.

grammar.pinyin: Tā zuì jìn hěn máng, shèn zhì zhōu mò yě zài gōng zuò.
grammar.english: He's been so busy that he's even working on weekends.

grammar.pinyin: Kuài xià yǔ le, wǒ men gǎn jǐn huí jiā.
grammar.english: It's about to rain; let's hurry home.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men zhì shǎo xū yào sān tiān de shí jiān.
grammar.english: We need at least three days.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu diǎnr chǎo.
grammar.english: It's a little noisy here.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men kuài diǎn chū fā, bù rán huì chí dào.
grammar.english: Let's leave quickly, otherwise we'll be late.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men zuì hǎo tí qián yù yuē.
grammar.english: We'd better book in advance.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ gū jì tā hái yǒu shí fēn zhōng cái dào.
grammar.english: I reckon he'll arrive in another ten minutes.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ huì jǐn liàng zǎo diǎn dào.
grammar.english: I'll try to arrive as early as I can.

grammar.pinyin: Tā tīng dào xiāo xi yǐ hòu lián máng huí jiā.
grammar.english: After hearing the news, he rushed home.

grammar.markup: {你}{可以}{向}{经理}{反映}{这}{个}{问题}。
grammar.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ xiàng jīng lǐ fǎn yìng zhè ge wèn tí.
grammar.english: You can raise this issue with the manager.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān bù dé bù jiā bān.
grammar.english: I have no choice but to work overtime today.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ gēn běn bù rèn shi tā.
grammar.english: I don't know him at all.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ zhōng yú bǎ zhè ge wèn tí jiě jué le.
grammar.english: I finally solved the problem.

grammar.markup: {既然}{已经}{晚}{了}，{干脆}{坐}{出租车}{吧}。
grammar.pinyin: Jì rán yǐ jīng wǎn le, gān cuì zuò chū zū chē ba.
grammar.english: Since we're already late, we might as well take a taxi.

grammar.markup: {既然}{你}{有空}，{我们}{就}{一起}{去}{吃饭}。
grammar.pinyin: Jì rán nǐ yǒu kòng, wǒ men jiù yī qǐ qù chī fàn.
grammar.english: Since you're free, let's eat together.

grammar.pinyin: Tā bì jìng shì xīn lái de tóng shì.
grammar.english: After all, he's a new colleague.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi huì hěn nán, jié guǒ fǎn ér hěn jiǎn dān.
grammar.english: I thought it would be difficult, but it turned out to be easy.

grammar.markup: {除非}{下雨}，{不然}{我们}{就}{去}{徒步}。
grammar.pinyin: Chú fēi xià yǔ, bù rán wǒ men jiù qù tú bù.
grammar.english: Unless it rains, we'll go hiking.

grammar.markup: {不管}{天气}{怎么样}，{我们}{都}{会}{出发}。
grammar.pinyin: Bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng, wǒ men dōu huì chū fā.
grammar.english: No matter what the weather is like, we'll set off.
